records.name: Submaximal Linear Deceleration to Stick
records.prerequisiteInterpretation: The inspected source does not explicitly require a previously successful jog-stop. Observing a controlled walking stop may establish the walking/bilateral-finish prerequisite before a first gentle jog-stop if pain-free easy-jog ability is independently known or observed and remaining gates fit. Walking practice alone does not establish easy-jog ability or qualify a jog-stop.

exactMechanics.approach: Declared 5-10 metre submaximal linear JOG approach, with declared entry intensity and no reactive release, turn or redirect.
exactMechanics.braking: Begin braking BEFORE the marked brake zone; use multiple controlled contacts to slow. No fixed universal contact count is specified. Avoid one hard reaching stop.
exactMechanics.finish: Stop inside the protected finish zone and own a balanced BILATERAL athletic stick. Alternating braking contacts do not make the terminal position a single-leg or prescribed split-stance finish.
exactMechanics.hold: Declared terminal hold; legacy tempo specifies two seconds. Both feet controlled, quiet balanced stance, no extra turn or reacceleration.
exactMechanics.reset: Walk back via the declared protected route after the owned finish and fully recover. This reset is not an additional timed shuttle or conditioning repeat.
exactMechanics.arms: Exact contract does not fix an arm style; any prescribed arm action is session context, not an extracted source rule.
exclusions: walking substituted silently for the exact jog approach
single hard plant or fixed one-step stop
exactMechanics.exposureAccounting: Source landingContactsPerRep=0 does not mean zero running/braking impacts. Record actual approaches, approach distance/context and braking contacts separately from intentional jump/landing events. Invalid attempts remain actual exposures.
exactMechanics.boundary: The source names historical sprint/deceleration aliases but the exact candidate restricts the current task to declared submaximal jogging with a bilateral finish.

prerequisites: Pain-free easy jogging AND a controlled walking stop.
Safe protected lane and shared understood stop signal.
Actual braking, impact, lower-body, technical-fatigue, supervision and time budgets fit.

output.intensity: declared 60-70 percent only if movement-intelligence profile is already clean
output.boundary: Not an automatic beginner progression or reason to increase OR-03 speed.

contactExposureModel.status: authored planning estimate; not observed contacts or a universal safety cap

sourceDoseNotSessionPrescription.boundary: Source percent intensities are contextual estimates, not measured fractions of an established maximum. Root must specify actual easy intent, bounded attempts, recovery placement and full coaching/return clock. Lower dose or shorter-than-5m approach is a labeled instructional adaptation.

sourceClearance.surface: clear, level, dry, high-traction non-slip lane
sourceClearance.traffic: One athlete per protected lane; next release only after previous athlete clears finish and walk-back route. No cross traffic.
sourceClearance.boundary: Do not replace the total 15-30m lane requirement with the 5-10m approach distance or fit source155 into a 3m personal bay.

stopRules: Stop for symptoms, giving way, slip, unsafe lane or athlete request.
Late braking, overrun, hard reaching stop, collapse, imbalance or an added turn ends a valid attempt; record actual exposure.
Reduce demand only if control returns. If early multistep braking and balanced stick cannot be restored, end this task and revalidate another option.
alternativeEligibility: WALK-STOP is locally suggested as a new variant but lacks a verified completed exact variant/profile; use only as an explicitly authored walking prerequisite lesson.
SNAP-STICK provides a no-travel grounded position-acquisition task if its own rapid-descent prerequisites fit. It observes no locomotor braking.
A slow no-travel bilateral position rehearsal is a separate declared adaptation; successful squat/stance control does not qualify jogging stops.
remainingGates: Current canonical owner, exact variant/profile and human approval remain unknown; migration/source UUID is not live approval.
Verify full lane and protection, stance, arm rule, approach, braking/finish/runoff zones, stop cue, hold, reset, actual lower-body exposure and supervision.
Confirm controlled walking stop and pain-free easy jog before selecting source-exact approach.
Resolve media, relationship, calibration and publication gates; source testPacket is quarantined.

records.name: Walk-to-Stick — proposed instructional variant
records.sourceEvidence: The generated research names Walk-to-Stick as new_variant with approachSpeed=walk; legacy scaling mentions fast walk-to-stick and walk/jog to controlled stop. The current exact source155 variant remains a 5-10m jog and gives no walking dose/profile.
records.proposedMechanicsForRootToSpecify: A declared short straight walk, early smooth reduction over several comfortable steps, controlled two-foot finish in a visible zone, declared hold, then an explicit safe reset. No jog, race, cue-response stop, sharp one-step plant, turn or reacceleration is implied.
missingDetails: slow-down cue location versus finish zone
records.eligibilityBoundary: This can be a transparent proposed OR-03 prerequisite lesson, not a currently approved source155 walking profile. Record walking-stop observations only; do not claim jogging or higher-speed braking competence.
remainingGates: Root must supply complete reviewable walking instructions and dose.
Resolve/review the exact walking variant and contextual profile before operational release.
No fabricated source/variant/profile ID and no assumption that a research alternate is an approved library record.

records.name: Split Squat — Supported Bodyweight

exactMechanics.supportBase: Stationary asymmetrical BILATERAL support: whole lead foot and rear forefoot on the floor; rear heel raised. Lead-leg bias is not a single-leg balance hold.
exactMechanics.stance: Declare lead side, length and width; preserve the same stationary split stance through each descent and return. No stepping lunge or elevated foot.
exactMechanics.movement: Lower both knees through owned pain-free range with lead-foot contact and knee path controlled; drive through the lead leg back to the same balanced stance. Keep pelvis/trunk/breath organized.
exactMechanics.support: Stable hand support. Exact variant seed lists rack; definition allows wall/rack and legacy scaling mentions a hand on wall. No exact numeric hand height, same/opposite lead-side hand, grip, or contact force is fixed.
exactMechanics.sideAndHeightDecision: Root must declare support structure, selected hand relative to lead leg, comfortable contact height/reach, continuous versus intermittent contact, and how the setup mirrors or changes when lead side switches. Those choices are session annotations requiring fit/review, not extracted source facts.
exactMechanics.cadence: Exact variant tempo_contract=controlled_standard. Legacy record has 2-0-1-0; current source time model uses a six-second repetition estimate plus four-second reset. Do not conflate estimates or impose an unstated fixed hold.
exactMechanics.finish: Same split stance, then safe exit and deliberate side change; both lead sides separately counted.
exclusions: long isometric hold substituted as a dynamic rep
manual assistance or heavy unplanned support hidden as balance contact
exactMechanics.exposureAccounting: Zero intentional flight/landing events; record repetitions and support per lead side.

prerequisites: Can lower and return without stepping.
Controlled lead foot/knee, pelvis/trunk and breathing.
Can follow lead-side, range, tempo, support, finish and stop rules; support and surface secure.

capacityStrength.effort: two or more quality repetitions remain

resilienceControl.effort: light to moderate with position priority

sourceDoseNotSessionPrescription.boundary: Low instructional repetitions/rest are authored session choices; count entry, both sides, support contact, exit and side change. Short holds within a dynamic rep are not the separate sustained isometric profile.

sourceClearance.sourceEquipmentBoundary: If selecting wall under a rack-listed variant, explicitly reconcile the support equipment/profile. No freestanding bench/chair support equivalence was verified.

stopRules: Stop for pain, numbness, dizziness, giving way, apprehension, unstable support or lost stationary stance.
Stop or reduce owned demand for lead-foot/knee control loss, rear-leg drive, pelvis/trunk change or failed breathing; do not complete a quota through faults.
Record meaningful side differences; equality of planned repetitions does not mean equal actual competence.
remainingGates: Current canonical owner, exact support variant/profile and human approval.
Declare hand side/height/contact and reconcile wall versus rack equipment before operational use.
Verify actual stable supports and coach sightlines for each athlete; equipment catalog names do not establish quantity.
No current Prepare and Access or dedicated instructional profile verified; early teaching placement/dose is an explicit contextual adaptation.

records.name: Supported Bodyweight Mid-Range Split Squat Hold
records.prerequisiteInterpretation: No prior fixed-duration hold is explicitly required. Establish comfortable split stance, controlled descent, safe exit from assigned depth and normal breathing before a first brief hold. Appending a bilateral exit/hold is a declared composite beyond source212.

exactMechanics.entry: Set declared split stance using stable wall/rack support, then lower under control to a recorded comfortable mid-range depth marker.
exactMechanics.supportBase: Whole front foot grounded, rear forefoot on floor with rear heel raised; rear knee HOVERS and does not rest. This is asymmetrical bilateral support with front-leg bias.
exactMechanics.hold: Hold the exact depth with declared upright or slight-incline torso, knee tracking, organized pelvis/ribs and continuous breathing; no repeated lower/stand cycles during the hold.
exactMechanics.support: Stable wall or rack. Source explicitly requires declared support height; profile requires light stable support without unplanned bodyweight transfer. It does not fix numeric height or which hand relative to lead leg.
exactMechanics.sideAndHeightDecision: Root must prescribe exact support hand/side/contact height and effort, compatible grip/reach, and controlled entry/exit and side change. Both lead sides have separate quality time.
exactMechanics.exit: Use support to rise or step out under control before position/breath changes. Do not rest rear knee to prolong the clock.
exclusions: tall stance-only hold presented as exact mid-range variant
exactMechanics.exposureAccounting: Zero intentional flight/landing events; actual clean hold seconds per lead side, entry and exit recorded separately.

prerequisites: Controlled split-squat descent and safe exit from assigned depth.
Stable support and individually fitting stance/depth; participant can exit without collapse.

sourceDoseNotSessionPrescription.boundary: A brief instructional hold below these ranges is a labeled dose override. Very shallow/tall stance-only rehearsal also changes the stated mid-range variant. Choose actual owned depth rather than forcing depth or pretending the learner completed an exact mid-range hold.

sourceClearance.supportRequirement: stable wall or rack with declared contact height
sourceClearance.boundary: The source's clearExitAreaMeters field does not specify radius/length geometry. Root must lay out a real clear exit and coaching access; do not convert it silently into a universal square footprint.

stopRules: End quality time for pain, pinching, giving way, neurologic/dizziness/pressure symptoms or unsafe exit.
End before depth drift, knee/foot/pelvic/trunk change, rear-knee rest, breath holding or unplanned support loading.
A shorter comfortable hold does not justify adding make-up sets automatically.
remainingGates: Current canonical owner, exact support/depth/profile and human approval.
Declare support hand/side/height/contact, stance, depth marker, torso, hold, breathing and exit; verify real supports and both-side fit.
Reconcile wall-profile equipment with rack if that support is selected.
Instructional/Movement Intelligence placement and lower dose require explicit contextual rationale; neither source profile is an exact dedicated on-ramp teaching profile.

records.name: Supported High Split-Stance Hold — instructional adaptation
records.sourceRelationship: Source212 supports related split-stance contacts, stable hand support, declared stance/depth, breathing and controlled exit. This higher shallow teaching action is newly authored documentation, not the source212 supported-bodyweight-mid-range identity or an approved new library card.
records.branchSelection: Use when comfortable supported split standing is available but controlled descent, safe exit or other mid-range entry gates are unknown or unmet. Athletes with established exact mid-range readiness may use their separate mid-range branch. No universal tall-stance reset is required.

exactProposedMechanics.setup: Use the individually fitting declared stable wall contact. Root's proposed hand rule is the hand on the front-leg side at that athlete's comfortable waist-height contact, free hand at hip; record actual contact height and fit. These are session choices, not source212-fixed instructions.
exactProposedMechanics.feet: Whole lead foot and rear forefoot remain on the floor in a comfortable declared split stance, rear heel raised. Preserve the same two-foot support through the hold; this is not a single-leg balance hold.
exactProposedMechanics.entry: From comfortable supported split standing, use only a self-selected small knee bend at a high shallow position. Establish controlled entry and return at THAT actual shallow depth before accepting the hold. Do not force the source212 mid-range depth.
exactProposedMechanics.hold: Keep the selected shallow height, front-foot contact, comfortable knee/pelvis/trunk organization and normal breathing with light stable hand contact. Rear knee does not rest. Hold only for the explicitly assigned short teaching time.
exactProposedMechanics.exit: Use the declared support to return under control to supported standing and change lead side as separately taught and timed.
exactProposedMechanics.deferRule: If comfortable shallow entry, breathing, support or exit cannot be established, defer this high-stance task and record not observed. Do not force the bend, use prolonged support loading, or silently substitute the mid-range hold.
exclusions: unplanned heavy bodyweight transfer to the hand support

prerequisites: Comfortable supported split standing with the declared stable hand and foot contacts.
Controlled entry and safe return at the actual selected shallow depth; mid-range descent/exit is not required for this separate adaptation.
Normal breathing and understanding of the stop/exit instruction.
Individually fitting stable support, clear exit and coach observation.

proposedInstructionalDoseNotSourceDefaul.rootChoices: Short 3-second or 5-second holds per lead side as explicitly assigned in P1/S1; root owns final repetitions/sets, rest, side-change, setup/exit and full clock.
proposedInstructionalDoseNotSourceDefaul.boundary: These times are authored teaching choices, not source212 profile defaults and not an approved lower-dose mid-range variant.

p1CompositeBoundary.rootProposedAdditionalAction: After the split-stance exit, enter the separately declared supported bilateral stance and hold for 2 seconds.
p1CompositeBoundary.identityStatus: The added bilateral exit-and-hold is part of a proposed P1 orientation composite; the complete sequence has no verified single canonical exercise ID.
p1CompositeBoundary.validation: Specify and observe the bilateral transition/stance, support contact and controlled exit, and count its time separately.
p1CompositeBoundary.competencyResult: High split-stance and supported bilateral orientation observations only; no mid-range, dynamic split-squat, walking-stop or jogging-stop pass.

records.exposureAccounting: Zero intentional flight/landing events. Record actual high-stance hold seconds and entry/exit quality separately for each lead side; the P1 bilateral hold is a separate action.
stopRules: Stop for symptoms, giving way, unsafe support or participant request.
End the hold for loss of assigned shallow position, foot/knee/pelvis/trunk control, rear-knee rest, breath holding or unplanned support loading.
If controlled entry/exit at the chosen shallow depth is unavailable, defer and record not observed rather than adding attempts to earn a pass.
records.competencyBoundary: Completion establishes only the performed supported high/shallow stance at its actual hand contact, foot geometry, bend and short hold. It does not establish source212 mid-range descent/exit/hold or dynamic split-squat competence.
remainingGates: Root must fully specify and clock the actual P1/S1 branch, side change, support contact, exit and any bilateral composite action.
Retain explicit documentation-only adaptation status; no exact source UUID/profile or live approval is assigned.
Verify actual support and shallow-depth readiness; use an independently qualified mid-range branch only when its own gates fit.

records.name: Quiet Bilateral Standing — orientation teaching task
records.provenance: Explicit OR-03 documentation task requested by the program author. No exact local canonical exercise/profile or source-specific dose was verified or assigned.
usedBy: P1 zero-split orientation when split entry is unknown
P2/E1 quiet-standing branch when locomotor or squat work is unavailable but quiet standing is independently safe
records.independentEligibility: Comfortable quiet bilateral standing at the actual location must be independently known or observed. Inability to perform another task does not establish standing readiness. If standing safety/comfort is unknown or unavailable, defer this task and record not observed.

exactProposedMechanics.setup: Use an already comfortable stationary two-foot standing position on a clear stable surface. Explain the hold and stop signal while the athlete remains standing.
exactProposedMechanics.action: Remain quietly upright with arms relaxed and knees unlocked for two seconds. No step, prescribed lowering, squat, split stance, deliberate lean or locomotor approach is part of the task.
exactProposedMechanics.finish: Release the hold instruction and remain in comfortable standing while receiving the reset cue; no stepping or lowering is required for reset.
exactProposedMechanics.boundary: The setup/hold/reset envelope is orientation and observation of already comfortable standing. It is not a requirement to transfer from an unsafe position or prove safe standing by attempting another movement.

proposedInstructionalDoseNotSourceDefaul.envelope: Ten seconds total includes explanation/setup, the two-second quiet hold and reset instruction. Root owns the exact division of the remaining eight seconds; no hidden extra steps, lowering repetitions or repeated holds.
proposedInstructionalDoseNotSourceDefaul.status: Authored OR-03 teaching choice, not a canonical profile default.

records.exposureAccounting: Zero intentional flight/landing events; zero locomotor distance, split-stance entries, braking attempts or lowering repetitions. Record one two-second quiet-standing observation only if performed comfortably.
records.competencyBoundary: No braking, walking/jogging stop, split-stance, mid-range hold, squat, lowering or dynamic split-squat pass is earned. Those unavailable or unobserved actions remain explicitly not observed.
stopRules: Stop for symptoms, discomfort, giving way, loss of balance, unsafe surface or participant request.
If independently comfortable quiet standing is not available, defer and record not observed; do not introduce support, stepping or lowering as an unnamed substitute.
remainingGates: Retain documentation-only task status and unset exact canonical/profile IDs.
Verify actual standing comfort, surface, communication and coach observation.
Root must preserve the single two-second hold within the ten-second setup/hold/reset envelope and record the limited observation.

noTravelAlternatives.preservedTask: Grounded rapid tall-to-athletic bilateral descent with two-second stick, no flight or rebound, followed by full reset.

noTravelAlternatives.lostPurpose: No walking/jogging approach or momentum braking observed; does not qualify source155.
noTravelAlternatives.sourceLimits: Retain earlier source-clearance, arm-start and current approval gates.

noTravelAlternatives.eligibility: Only comfortable owned squat mechanics; if changing it into a static athletic hold, declare the adaptation.
noTravelAlternatives.lostPurpose: No locomotor stop, rapid snap-down or split-stance competence; record those not observed.

Retain three-count lower, brief pause and controlled stand; no mandatory box.
Retain stable individually fitting support height and exact push-up mechanics.
Opposite hand AND knee support on bench; both-side load/setup accounting. Hand-only row is different.
Fixed vertical arms and owned tabletop heel-contact return; explicit count unit; Strength placement remains contextual adaptation of Prepare and Access profile.
